TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Irou mattæ'i-kaha ta ti Je-sus ki mamang k'atta, ni-tpæpænæh lam ki Pahtatæutæu-han tyn mou-arugh ki karout-kout ki Cedron, ka akou raoul hynna, ki ni-sa-rarbou-en tyn ki Pahtatæutæu-han-appa tyn.
S.TRANSL: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
耶穌說了這話，就同門徒出去，過了汲淪溪。在那裏有一個園子，他和門徒進去了。

S.FORM: Ka ti Judas ka ni-si-vannavanna tyni-æn, ta mou-mhga-appa ki i-tou-kou-'an k'anna, alei ka vounnavounnei ni-mæui-sal-ato hynna ta ti Jesus lam ki Pahta-tæutæu-han tyn.
S.TRANSL: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
賣耶穌的猶大也知道那地方，因為耶穌和門徒屢次上那裏去聚集。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-patou-lam ta ti Judas tyni-æn [ki tama-macyt] ki [raroum'-appa] ka koungcia ki Tama-p'hik ka si-bavau, ki Fari-seen-appa, ni-ierroua hynna mei-koua ki patta-'æ-uyng an, ki eu-nam ka ta-æuyng-an, ki peika-kou-an-appa macyt.
S.TRANSL: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
猶大領了一隊兵，和祭司長並法利賽人的差役，拿着燈籠、火把、兵器，就來到園裏。

S.FORM: Ka dou kavan-'an ti Jesus ta mamang ka pa-ierroua-eih tyni-æn, ni tpæpænæh ta teni k'ma neini-æn, Timang ta ki'ym-noumi?
S.TRANSL: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
耶穌知道將要臨到自己的一切事，就出來對他們說：「你們找誰？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i v'lli ta neni tyni-æn, Ti Jesus-an ka makka Nazareth. Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Ti jau k'atta. Ka ti Judas ka si-vannavanna tyni-æn, ta i-tou-lam-appa neini-æn mi-toukko.
S.TRANSL: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
他們回答說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」耶穌說：「我就是！」賣他的猶大也同他們站在那裏。

S.FORM: Irou ka mattæ'i-komma-hynna ta teni nei-ni-æn, Ti jau k'atta, ni-sai-tatara ta neni mou-aryng tou næi.
S.TRANSL: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
耶穌一說「我就是」，他們就退後倒在地上。

S.FORM: Annata ni-tmauki-la ta teni tmaligh neini-æn, Ti-mang ta ki'ym noumi? Ka ni-k'ma ta neni, Ti Jesus-an ka makka Na-zareth.
S.TRANSL: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
他又問他們說：「你們找誰？」他們說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus, Pattæ'i-kah'-an-ato-mau-kamou ka ti jau katta. Heirou kmi-'ym-kamou jau-an, pad'arang-au-to ta neni k'atta.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
耶穌說：「我已經告訴你們，我就是。你們若找我，就讓這些人去吧。」

S.FORM: Alei ka paveut-tauh ta sou ka ni-pa-sousou-en tyn: neni ka ni-phæ-en-hou jou-an, assi-mau ni pa-tau-rumma-en ta ti mamang.
S.TRANSL: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
這要應驗耶穌從前的話，說：「你所賜給我的人，我沒有失落一個。」

S.FORM: Ka ti Simon Petrus ka mei-tierrau, ta ni-lmouhgout ki anna, ka ni-maphyt ki koungcia ki Dadyllo ka Si-bavau, ka ni-palikkud tyn ta tangira tyn ka ouwal. Ka ti Malchus ta nanang ki koungcia kanna.
S.TRANSL: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
西門‧彼得帶着一把刀，就拔出來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那僕人名叫馬勒古。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta ti Je-sus ti Petrus-an, Pou-karouloung-au ta tierrau oho. Hæuugh kanna ka æ̈yht-tæn ka na pæp'æ ki Ra-ma jau-an, assi-mau yht-tei ta anna?
S.TRANSL: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
耶穌就對彼得說：「收刀入鞘吧，我父所給我的那杯，我豈可不喝呢？」

S.FORM: Annata kabatoung-an k'anna, ki Meisasou-appa ki sat katounnoun-an lam ki koungcia ki Joden ni-ta-sal ta yng'it ti Jesus-an bæuut tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
那隊兵和千夫長，並猶太人的差役就拿住耶穌，把他捆綁了，

S.FORM: Ka ni-mad tyni-æn si-ou-rou ti Annas-an: alei ka raram-an ta teni ki kei-jen ti Ka-i-fas, ka Dadyllo ka Si-bavau tou tauwil k'anna.
S.TRANSL: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
先帶到亞那面前，因為亞那是本年作大祭司該亞法的岳父。

S.FORM: Ka ti Ka-i-fas ta ti anna ka ni-matamha ki Joden, ka ma-riang-âl-ato, rou kapatei-eih ki saät ki voual mi-v'lli ki ta'u.
S.TRANSL: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
這該亞法就是從前向猶太人發議論說「一個人替百姓死是有益的」那位。

S.FORM: Ka ni-smala-dyllough ta ti Simon Petrus ti Jesus-an, lam ki Pahtatæutæu-han ka pani. Ka Pahtatæutæu-han kanna ta k'a-lang-in ki Dadyllo ka Si-bavau, ka ni-sa-rarbo-en tyn lam ti Je-sus-an tou laf ki Dadyllo ka Sibavau.
S.TRANSL: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
西門‧彼得跟着耶穌，還有一個門徒跟着。那門徒是大祭司所認識的，他就同耶穌進了大祭司的院子。

S.FORM: Ka ti Petrus ta i-tou ma-la myttouhko tou ngangataf-'an. Annata Pahtatæutæu-han kanna ka pani ka k'alang-in ki Dadyllo ka Si-bavau, ni-sa-mamala, mat-tæ'i tavægh ki Souajam tou nga-ngataf-an, ka ni-papadak-k'nan tyn ti Petrus-an.
S.TRANSL: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
彼得卻站在門外。大祭司所認識的那個門徒出來，和看門的使女說了一聲，就領彼得進去。

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma ti Pe-trus-an ta ina kanna ka koungcia ka souajam tou ngataf, Assi kau-wa ymhou-appa ta na Pahtatæutæuugh ki voual katta? Ni-k'ma ta teni, Assi ti jau.
S.TRANSL: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
那看門的使女對彼得說：「你不也是這人的門徒嗎？」他說：「我不是。」

S.FORM: Ka pa'irong-en ki koung-cia-appa kanna ta mytouhko tou ni-si-apoepoei-en ka na væ'æ, alei ki maharmil pakalado neini-æn, ka ti Petrus ta i-tou-lam neini-æn myttouhko pakalado tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
僕人和差役因為天冷，就生了炭火，站在那裏烤火；彼得也同他們站着烤火。

S.FORM: Annata ni-tmaligh ta Da-dyllo ka Si-bavau ti Jesus-an alei ki Pahtatæutæu-'han tyn, ki ni-pahtæutæu-en-nappa tyn.
S.TRANSL: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
大祭司就以耶穌的門徒和他的教訓盤問他。

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus tyni-æn, Ni-pattæ'i-dingding-en-nau ki sou tou næi: ni-myhkakoua-koh mahtæutæuugh tou Pæu-i-sasal-lan, tou Kouva-appa ki tatamm'dden ki Alid, tou pa-æuäklakl'-an ki massi-euma-eu-ma ka Joden: ka assi-koh ni-ma-sousou tou ding ki mamang.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
耶穌回答說：「我從來是明明地對世人說話。我常在會堂和殿裏，就是猶太人聚集的地方教訓人；我在暗地裏並沒有說甚麼。

S.FORM: Mang ka tmaligh-kow jau-an? tmalig-â neini-æn ka ni-millingigh, mang ta na sou-au nei-ni-æn, k'it-tei, mou-mhga ta ne-ni k'atta mang ta na sou au.
S.TRANSL: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
你為甚麼問我呢？可以問那聽見的人，我對他們說的是甚麼；我所說的，他們都知道。」

S.FORM: Irou ka pa-sousou-en tyn ta atta, saät ki koungcia ka i-tou-sal hynna mytouhko, ta ni-tmaplagh ti Jesus-an tou timi, ka ni-koun-tyn, Mattæ'i-v'lli-ah-kow komma-hynna ki sou ki Dadyllo ka Si-bavau?
S.TRANSL: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
耶穌說了這話，旁邊站着的一個差役用手掌打他，說：「你這樣回答大祭司嗎？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus tyni-æn, Hei-rou ni-mattæ'i-rma-rma-koh ki sou, gmail-lâ ki ni-pattæ'i-rma-rm-'an: heirou ni-kmæ-'msing-koh, ka oumang ka tmaplagh-kow jau-an?
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
耶穌說：「我若說的不是，你可以指證那不是；我若說的是，你為甚麼打我呢？」

S.FORM: (Ka ti Annas ta ni-pa-ad-dato tyni-æn pa-'ou-koua ti Kaifas-an ka Dadyllo ka Si-ba-vau.)
S.TRANSL: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
亞那就把耶穌解到大祭司該亞法那裏，仍是捆着解去的。

S.FORM: Ka ni-myttouhko ta ti Simon Petrus pakalado tyni-æn: annata ni-k'ma ta neni tyni-æn', Assi kauwa ymhou-appa ta na Pah-tatæutæuugh tyn? Ni-rmau ta te-ni, k'ma, Assi ti jau.
S.TRANSL: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
西門‧彼得正站着烤火，有人對他說：「你不也是他的門徒嗎？」彼得不承認，說：「我不是。」

S.FORM: Saät ka koungcia ki Da-dyllo ka Si-bavau, ka mahka ta'u-ta'u-ei tyni-æn ka ni-paluk't-ten ti Petrus ki tangira, ta ni-k'ma, Assi-mau kow kauwa ni-k'yt-tan tou raoul ka tou-lam-kow tyni-æn?
S.TRANSL: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
有大祭司的一個僕人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的親屬，說：「我不是看見你同他在園子裏嗎？」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mi-la rmau ta ti Pe-trus. Ka madys ni-mouni ta taoukka.
S.TRANSL: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
彼得又不承認。立時雞就叫了。

S.FORM: Annata ni-mad ta neni ti Jesus-an padarang ti Kaifas-an pa-'ou-koua tou talagh ka kei-rang-en ki papamæmæg-hen. Ka mæræræmæh-ato ka madama: ka assi ni-mou-rbo ta neni tou talagh ki pæpæmæmæ'-hen, alei ka assi æhid-deih, râ kman-al-appa ta ne-ni i-oukko ki Halidaæu-en.
S.TRANSL: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
眾人將耶穌從該亞法那裏往衙門內解去，那時天還早。他們自己卻不進衙門，恐怕染了污穢，不能吃逾越節的筵席。

S.FORM: Annata ni-sa-mamala ta ti Pilatus mou-pænæh neini-æn, k'ma, Pat-barau-noumi ki mang ta ka'æuloung katta?
S.TRANSL: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
彼拉多就出來，到他們那裏，說：「你們告這人是為甚麼事呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vlli ta neni k'ma tyni-æn, Heirou ni-ynna pou-varau ta ti atta, ynna-kame assi pæ'æ-tounnoun tyni-æn ym-hou-an.
S.TRANSL: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
他們回答說：「這人若不是作惡的，我們就不把他交給你。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Pilatus nei-ni-æn, Arau tyni-æn ta ymoumi, ka dmungdung-a tyni-æn ki Ta-touhko-oumi. Anna ta ni-k'ma ta Joden tyni-æn, Assi-kame ha-hei-en pakapatey ti-mamang-an.
S.TRANSL: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
彼拉多說：「你們自己帶他去，按着你們的律法審問他吧。」猶太人說：「我們沒有殺人的權柄。」

S.FORM: Alei ka pavæut-auh ta na sou ti Jesus, ka ni-pa-sousou-en tyn, pou-kidi kapatei-an ki mang ka kapatei-tih tyn.
S.TRANSL: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
這要應驗耶穌所說自己將要怎樣死的話了。

S.FORM: Annata ni-mou-rbo ta ti Pilatus mila tou talach ki pæpæ-mæmæg-hen tmatææm ti Jesusan, k'ma tyni-æn, Mei-sasou kow kauwa ka Si-bavau ki Joden?
S.TRANSL: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
彼拉多又進了衙門，叫耶穌來，對他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus tyni-æn, Sykkounoung kow kauwa masousou ki atta, ni-van-navanna lava ta rarouma ymhou-an mat-tæ'i-mymmiâ jau-an?
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
耶穌回答說：「這話是你自己說的，還是別人論我對你說的呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Pi-latus, Jode-koh kauwa? ta'u-oho ki Tamap'hgik-appa ka Si-bavau ta ni-pæ'æ-tounnoun ymhou-an jau-an: kamang ta ni-pam't-ten-hou?
S.TRANSL: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
彼拉多說：「我豈是猶太人呢？你本國的人和祭司長把你交給我。你做了甚麼事呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Jesus, Assi makka næi katta ta Pei-sasou-an-nau: Heirou makka næi lava k'atta ta Pei-sasou-an-nau, ynna macyt ta mokoua-sy-dda-rim jau-an, ki assi-koh pæ'æ-toun-noun-nen ki Joden : râ hnyn as-si-tæ'i-koua hia ta Pei-sasou-an-nau.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
耶穌回答說：「我的國不屬這世界；我的國若屬這世界，我的臣僕必要爭戰，使我不至於被交給猶太人。只是我的國不屬這世界。」

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma ta ti Pi-latus tyni-æn, Mei-sasou kow kauwa ka Si-bavau? Ni-matta'i-v'lli ta ti Jesus Mattæ'i-'msing kow ka Mei-sasou-koh ka Si-bavau. Alei ki atta ni-pei-allak-kin koh, alei appa ki atta ierrou'-âto-koh tou næi, ki heil-ei-mau ta ka-tiktik-kan ki sou. Veiagh ka tæ'i-koua ki katiktik-kan ki sou, mil-ling-igh ki yngau-au.
S.TRANSL: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
彼拉多就對他說：「這樣，你是王嗎？」耶穌回答說：「你說我是王。我為此而生，也為此來到世間，特為給真理作見證。凡屬真理的人就聽我的話。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Pilatus ty-ni-æn, Ka mang ta katiktik-kan ki sou? Irou ka mattæ'i-kaha ki atta, ni-sa-mamala mi-la mou-koua ki Joden, k'ma neini-æn, Assi-mau paki-valei-en ta varau tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
彼拉多說：「真理是甚麼呢？」

S.FORM: Râ kidi-oumi ka 'æumi'-en-nau-kamou ta sasat rou 'Ou-vavatoug-han ki Hali-da-æu-en. Mamoei-kamou kauwa ka'æumi'-au-mau-kamou ta Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau ki Joden?
S.TRANSL: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
但你們有個規矩，在逾越節要我給你們釋放一個人，你們要我給你們釋放猶太人的王嗎？」

S.FORM: Annata ni-makou-ligh ta neni mi-la makou-ymmid, k'ma, Assi ti atta, ra ti Barrabas-appa. Ka na tama-l'poo'gh ta ti Barrabas.
S.TRANSL: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
他們又喊着說：「不要這人，要巴拉巴！」這巴拉巴是個強盜。
